response.rationale: R1 best explains the pemphigus-specific combination of acantholytic keratinocytes and intercellular IgG/C3 in the upper epidermis; the concurrent basement-membrane deposition and ANA positivity fit pemphigus erythematosus, a lupus-like pemphigus variant. C1 and R3 overfit the photodistributed rash and ANA but cannot account for acantholysis and intercellular DIF. R2 has no raw support and lacks muscle findings.

rejected.why: Its own raw support includes acantholysis and intercellular IgG/C3, which are pemphigus findings rather than lupus; negative anti-Ro/La/Smith and normal complement/ESR weaken SLE.
